lines.zh: 我是一匹普通的黏土马。
lines.en: I'm a plain clay horse.
My steps are heavy and dull.
My mane hasn't been coloured yet.
Step by step. Steady.
My prints show clearly in the soil.
I avoid stones so no corner chips.

lines.zh: 我走路的时候，身体会响。
lines.en: My body creaks as I walk.

lines.zh: 我是黏土和灵魂沙合出来的。
lines.en: I'm clay and soul sand together.
I walk along the wall, out of the wind.

lines.zh: 我这副泥身子，驮得动士兵。
lines.en: This clay body can carry a soldier.
My clay hoofprints are clear.
My shadow lies solid on the ground.
Not fast. But straight.
The grass bends where I pass.
Dust settles on my back; I don't shake it off.
This clay colour is how I came.
I'm waiting for someone to paint me.

lines.zh: 我身上有一层薄薄的灰。
lines.en: A fine dust coats me.

lines.zh: 我这匹黏土马，鬃毛还没上色。
lines.en: This clay horse of mine still has unpainted mane.
I have no smell but earth.
The wind takes a little dust off me.
I listen. Very quiet.
My four legs hold me up.

lines.zh: 我站着像一块石头，可我在看。
lines.en: I stand like stone, but I'm watching.
I want someone to ride me.
What I am isn't settled yet.
I tilt my head to the wind.
My mane is stiff as straw.
I'm waiting for the next step.
The sky is grey, much like me.
Are you going to paint me?

lines.zh: 黏土捏的马，等士兵上鞍。
lines.en: A clay horse, waiting for its rider.
Your hands are empty.
I shift a step toward you.
I don't know you. I'm not afraid.
Touch me and you'll get dust.
My back is still bare, waiting for a saddle.
I lower my head so you can see.
You're not made of clay.
I'll wait for your decision.
You have more colours than I do.
I step aside to let you pass.
You've got dust on your hands. Wipe it.
I watch your hands. Waiting.
A piece fell off. I can still stand.
That chipped my ear.
The clay I lost, I can't pick back up.
Dust all over the ground.
It doesn't hurt. There's a crack.
A piece of clay dents in my chest.
Dry soil trickles from the crack.
I'm only a lump of clay.
I tuck my forelegs under me.
My colour's been scuffed.

lines.zh: 黏土和灵魂沙捏成的马。
lines.en: A horse shaped from clay and soul sand.
I lower my head and sniff. Nothing.

lines.zh: 黏土不挑颜色，也不挑食。
lines.en: Clay is picky about neither color nor food.
I don't care for that colour.

lines.zh: 你要是想给我上色，来吧。
lines.en: If you want to colour me, go ahead.
I lean forward a little.
Clay can't eat.
I'm grey enough already.
That won't shape into my body.
I step back and hold.
You bump me and a bit of dust falls.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，站住，黏土蹄子陷进地里。
lines.en: I step back and stop; clay hooves sink in.
I angle aside to let you through.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的耳朵缺了一角。
lines.en: That chipped a corner off my ear.
I'm not sturdy. Don't push.
Afterward I check myself.
That knocked me crooked.
I get knocked half a turn off course.
You've got dust on you.
A dent is added to my body.
Two clay horses side by side.
We press our heads together.
Its colour is a shade darker.
Neither speaks. Only wind.
The earth will remember this.
We stand a long while, unmoving.
At dusk we go our ways.

lines.zh: 它身上也有灵魂沙的味道。
lines.en: It also smells of soul sand.
It leaves. I stay.
It recognizes me as I am.
I kick it over to the roadside.

lines.zh: 黏土马不饿，这东西用不上。
lines.en: A clay horse does not eat. No use for this.
I sniff. Wet soil.
I nudge it with a forehoof.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子太钝，夹不住它。
lines.en: My hooves are too blunt to pinch it.
It's stuck between my hooves.
I shake my leg. It falls.
I'll keep this. Might be useful.
It's no different from the soil here.
Everything here is earth.
Someone's saddling me. I stand firm.
I plant my hooves.
If you go, I'll follow.

lines.zh: 黏土做的我，蹄子一踩一个印。
lines.en: Clay hooves leave a print each step.
I don't like being pushed along.
I raise my head and wait for a word.
This body can still hold.
Step back and I won't move.
I face you, hooves spread.
Wherever you go, I'll carry you.
I wait for you to tighten the reins.
I can take this stretch.
I keep straight. Unchanged.
I follow half a step behind.
My ears point your way.
All clay, and I walk steady.
You stop, and my hooves stop too.
I know this soil.

lines.zh: 马蹄陷进土里，又拔出来。
lines.en: My hooves sink into the soil and pull free.
You pull the reins. I understand.
My prints run all along.
Wind from the west.
A stretch more to the wall.
I check before each step.
Slower. My legs are short.
I connect, and my hoof tip cracks.
I butt forward and my head goes crooked.
That shook dust off me.
This kick is just instinct.
I strike and retreat, afraid of coming apart.
That one, I misjudged.

lines.zh: 我的蹄印留在你衣服上。
lines.en: My hoofprint stays on your clothes.
The kick missed and I nearly fell.
I breathe once. Fine.
I won't chase; don't chase me.

lines.zh: 我从土里站起来，身上还没有颜色。
lines.en: I rise out of the earth. No colour yet.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子是黏土捏的，很轻。
lines.en: My hooves are clay, and light.

lines.zh: 这一片土，比我记得的硬。
lines.en: Harder soil than I remember.
First I look at my legs.
Someone made me. I await orders.
All four legs are set.
Bright here. I'm a little lost.

lines.zh: 我的四蹄从土里拔出来。
lines.en: My four hooves pull free of the earth.
I'll do the heavy work.

lines.zh: 我闻到了灵魂沙的味道。
lines.en: I smell soul sand.
Sun on me. Very dry.
No other horses here.
I've just come out of the soul sand.
I'm still the colour of earth.
I'll stand a moment and watch.
Someone will paint me.
Fire hardens my clay hide.
I fall from a height and a leg breaks.

lines.zh: 泥水渗进来，我直不起来。
lines.en: Muddy water seeps in; I can't straighten up.

lines.zh: 我被炸散，只剩半身立着。
lines.en: Blown apart, only half of me still stands.

lines.zh: 东西扎进黏土里，拔不出来。
lines.en: It's stuck in the clay.
Light binds me and my hooves won't lift.
The ground dried and I'm cracking.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我烧成一整块。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I bake solid.
No earth below. I fall.
